svg.title: Open Source Metro / Project journeys / SYNTHETIC DESIGN SHOWCASE
svg.desc: A compact 53-week Sunday-to-Saturday GitHub-style event calendar with up to five repository journeys aligned to the same week positions. Stops are observed events; merges are rings, releases diamonds. Rails between stops are schematic and do not mean continuous contributions. Blank days are unobserved, not verified zero contributions. This is not GitHub’s official contributions chart.

g.text: A year of source-backed project journeys
BLANK = NO OBSERVATION, NOT CONFIRMED INACTIVITY
